lastMessage:
feat: enhance widget validation workflow and add artifact uploads

- Updated widget validation workflow to trigger on broader file changes and added manual dispatch option.
- Changed validation script execution to use npm command.
- Added artifact upload step for validation reports.
- Updated README to reflect new widget release process and CI improvements.

chore: add performance and lighthouse workflows

- Introduced new workflows for performance testing using Playwright and Lighthouse.
- Set up scripts to measure widget performance and generate reports.
- Added documentation for new workflows and updated existing widget READMEs with versioning information.

fix: update widget versions and README documentation

- Incremented version numbers for several widgets and updated corresponding README files.
- Ensured all widgets maintain a consistent versioning format and archived older versions appropriately.
- Added dark mode audit utility and updated README files to include active version policies.

docs: create comprehensive widget documentation index

- Compiled an index of all widget documentation for easier navigation.
- Added dark mode audit checklist to standards documentation.
- Updated site documentation to include links to widget READMEs and usage instructions.
